results.overview: An action-packed preschool series about an adorable jet plane named Jett who travels the world delivering packages to children. On every delivery, Jett encounters a new problem that the he and his friends the Super Wings must work together to solve!
results.name: Super Wings

results.overview: Chaos ensues overnight when mysterious tombs suddenly surface, filled with divine relics granting overwhelming power, triggering a global power struggle to claim them for dominion. Among the havoc, a raider, Jooheon Suh, is betrayed and left for dead until a second chance brings him back years before the relics. Fueled by fury and future knowledge, he sets out to raid each tomb before they arise.
results.name: Tomb Raider King

results.overview: Four animal superheroes called the Miniforce transform into robots to protect small and defenseless creatures from the hands of scheming villains.
results.name: Miniforce

results.overview: Two curious worms spend their days investigating the otherworldly objects that fall through the grate into their subterranean world.
results.name: Larva

results.overview: Set free on Earth, fairies with magical powers begin influencing people's emotions. Now, it's up to a princess from a faraway kingdom to stop them!
results.name: Catch! Teenieping

results.overview: Fun adventures await in the forest named Porong Porong Village where Pororo and friends live. New friends show up in the village and many exciting things happen in the forest. Our playful little gentoo penguin Pororo, naughty spinosaurus Crong, sweet and lovely American beaver Loopy, cheerful and sporty Adélie penguin girl Petty, clever fennec fox Eddy, strong minikaniko Rody, trustworthy polar bear Poby, happy-go-lucky hummingbird Harry, magical dragon wizard Tong-Tong, and a red sedan car Tu-Tu live in this snow-covered wonderland.
results.name: Pororo the Little Penguin

results.overview: Follow Baby Shark Brooklyn and his best friend William as they journey on fun-filled comedic adventures in their community of Carnivore Cove, meet new friends, and sing original catchy tunes along the way.
results.name: Baby Shark's Big Show!

results.overview:
Bernard is a series of animated shorts centered on the fictional polar bear and main character of the same name. It is a Korean-Spanish-French co-production. Each three-minute episode focuses on the bear's curiosity and have many moments of slapstick. Bernard never speaks with the exception of unintelligible noises

Bernard is accompanied in the cartoons by a few other characters: Lloyd and Eva the penguins, Zack the lizard, Goliat the chihuahua, Sam the baby, Pilot the dog, Pokey the porcupine and Santa Claus. He usually gets knocked unconscious or severely injured at the end of an episode, due to some calamity caused by his bumbling
results.name: Bernard

results.overview: A kids' western centered on a kitty-cat sheriff whose job is to ensure that the town of Nice and Friendly Corners remains the friendliest town in the West.
results.name: Sheriff Callie's Wild West

results.overview: Rainbow Ruby is the story of a spunky, resourceful little girl who magically transports to Rainbow Village, a whimsical land inhabited by her toys, and transforms into different jobs to help save the day! This CGI-animated preschool series takes the childhood fantasy of dolls come to life, and mixes in an aspirational heroine who proves that you can be anything you want to be!
results.name: Rainbow Ruby

results.overview: An unexpected package is delivered to a school boy, Chatan. Chatan opens the box, but there is only an ordinary toy cube inside. However, as soon as Chatan touches the cube, a car-transformation robot appears.
results.name: Hello Carbot

results.overview: When disaster strikes in Brooms Town, police car Robocar Poli, fire truck Robotruck Roy and their friends on the rescue team race to save the day.
results.name: Robocar Poli

results.overview:
Doing what he can to pay his bills, Moon Shingun works as a rogue mechanic on the city streets. He barely scrapes by with this illegal work, so he does not think twice about convincing ignorant people with cash to burn to always return to him for his services.

The streets are far from safe, however, with the organized crime group known as the Mercifuls fighting their rivals for control. With drugs and death becoming commonplace in his hunting grounds, Shingun is looking to keep his pockets full; and when he overhears a car failing to start, its sound leads him to Jake Gillan, a Mercifuls member. Finding himself facing a man dressed to kill and with a seemingly bottomless wallet, Shingun believes he has hit the jackpot.
results.name: Shutline

results.overview: Set two years before the events of Clifford the Big Red Dog, the series focuses on when Clifford was a tiny red puppy. Clifford was the runt in a litter of puppies born to the pet dog of Emily Elizabeth's neighbor, Mr. Bradley (who appeared in an episode of the previous cartoon series, "Little Clifford"). He was adopted by Emily Elizabeth before he grew up into a giant red adult dog, forcing the Howard family to move out of their small apartment so Clifford would be able to live comfortably. The series shows Clifford and Emily Elizabeth's life and friends before they moved from the city to Birdwell Island.  Clifford's Puppy Days was produced by Scholastic Entertainment and Mike Young Productions and overseas animation services was by Sunwoo Entertainment and Yeson Animation Studios.
results.name: Clifford's Puppy Days

results.overview: One month into living on his own, Yi-hyuk was hoping for an exciting, dramatic start to his independent life—but not this kind of drama. What he doesn’t expect is to be tormented by the thunderous noise coming from the apartment next door. Determined to put an end to it, he confronts his neighbor—only to make things infinitely worse when he accidentally punches him in the face.Yi-hyuk tries everything—from childish pranks to petty power plays—but his neighbor just won’t budge. He even pleads on his knees to make the noise stop. Just when it seems the feud will never end, they finally manage to call an uneasy truce.And somewhere along the way, Yi-hyuk realizes he might be falling for the very person who once drove him up the wall.
results.name: Quiet Please!

results.overview: Tayo the Little Bus is a South Korean computer-generated animated television series created by Educational Broadcasting System, Iconix Entertainment, Seoul and Hot Animation which is owned by HiT Entertainment. The Korean-dubbed series began airing on EBS in 2010 and the English-dubbed series aired on Disney Junior in 2012. The latter is also scheduled to air on Disney Channel and Cartoonito in 2013. The narrator of the UK series is Michael Angelis who also narrates the UK series of Thomas & Friends.
results.name: Tayo the Little Bus

results.overview: Meet Bread! He's a brilliant cake decorator who gives amazing makeovers to customers in a town inhabited by quirky little food characters.
results.name: Bread Barbershop

results.overview:
Coming back to college as a sophomore, U-yun meets Jin-hyeong, a TA with a mysterious charm. After U-yun blurts out a sudden confession, the two unexpectedly end up living together in a studio apartment.

A week into living together, U-yun goes in for a deep, passionate kiss, but Jin-hyeong asks him to wait, revealing he has a very specific "fantasy" about physical intimacy.

Just what kind of fantasy is he talking about!? Will they be able to push past all their wild fantasies and delusions to successfully survive their first night together?

"I just want to know you better."
results.name: One-Room TA

results.overview: In a brutal underground world, a vampire medic and a wounded young fighter form a fragile bond—one built on pain, longing, and forbidden desire.
results.name: MIGNON

results.overview: Heroes can pop out of their comic books when summoned in this comedic action-adventure.
results.name: Hero Inside
